eligibilitySummary.zhTw: 適用於通常居住在歐盟以外的旅客；須由商店開立退稅文件並在離開歐盟時完成海關出口驗證。退款由商家處理，海關不直接退款。
eligibilitySummary.enUs: Available to travelers habitually resident outside the EU when the shop issues a tax-free sales slip and Customs validates export on leaving the EU. The merchant, not Customs, handles any refund.

sources.title: La détaxe en France pour les touristes - PABLO

observedFacts: Visitors habitually resident outside the EU may have VAT deducted from goods bought in France under the tax-free procedure.
The customs export validation at the EU exit gives the seller the definitive VAT exemption.
French Customs states that the administration does not refund the VAT; the merchant is the party that can reimburse it.
limitations: The source does not establish that every retailer issues a tax-free sales slip or refunds VAT.
Rolex retailer participation and any processing fee are not established by this evidence.
